Slime King

Download Now

Welcome!

Welcome to the world of Slime King, an exciting adventure where you lead a squad of cute and fighting slimes! Travel through dangerous lands, collect resources, rescue captive slimes and fight formidable enemies to protect the kingdom of slimes!

ABOUT GAMEPLAY

Manage your squad of slimes

Form your squad by choosing from different types of slimes, each with their own unique abilities and roles. Some have high damage and health, some are good at shooting, some heal the squad, and some increase the amount of resources collected.

Explore the world

Travel the world, collect apples and water to survive and improve your squad. Apples are the slimes' currency, and water is their energy. Slimes can use magic if they have enough water.

Fight enemies

The more slimes in your squad, the more actively the enemies attack. Sometimes it is better to run away from the battlefield so as not to lose your slimes. Each enemy has its own characteristics: some are strong in close combat, some can eat bullets, and some can swallow your slime whole.


Save other slimes

Find houses in which slimes are hiding and take them to your squad. All slimes have strengths and weaknesses, it is important to consider where the slime will stand in the squad.
